e.body:
**InsurancePolicyInterpretationLegalBenchClassification**（ModelScope 数据集 `MTEB/InsurancePolicyInterpretationLegalBenchClassification`）**是一个**面向**保单条款解读**的**评测子集****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**中国的模型与数据集平台：数据集这一面**」**。

**可核实信息（均 ModelScope 数据集接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一个只有 **40 KB 的评测集****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**存储大小逐字为 **40,590 字节**（**约 **40 KB**）**、**许可逐字为 **`cc-by-4.0`**、**下载 **21 次**、**类型 **4**（**数据集）**、**创建 **1780308586**（**2026-06-01T10:09:46Z**）**、**平台记录的修改时间 **1789111727**（**2026-09-11T07:28:47Z**）****。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**40 KB 也是一项基准**」**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**评测集的价值**不取决于**体量**，**而**取决于**它**测什么**、**答案**是否**可判定****；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**一个**几百条**的**保险条款判读**子集**，**可以**比**一个**几十万条**的**通用语料**更**能说明**模型**是否**懂**条款**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 卡片开头写着一行**可核对的**出处****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 **README 首行**逐字为**一条 HTML 注释**：**「**adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface_hub/blob/v0.30.2/src/huggingface_hub/templates/datasetcard_template.md**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条最值得记的**：**⭐ 即**数据集**卡片**这一**形式**本身**也在**跨平台流通****——**⭐ 一个**由 **MTEB 机构**发布在 **ModelScope 上的**数据集**，**其**卡片**骨架**来自**另一个平台**官方库**里的**模板文件**（**且**注明了**版本 **`v0.30.2`**）**；**⭐ 而**它**把**这件事**写在**第一行**，**而不是**抹掉**——**⭐ 这**正是**本会话多次记下的**「**说清哪一半是你的**」**在**数据集卡片**上的**落点**。**⭐⭐ ③ 引用写进了卡片本身****——**⭐ 本次实测**其 **README** 内含**两份 BibTeX 条目**，**逐字含 **arXiv **`2502.13595`**（**2025**）与 **`2210.07316`**（**2022，MTEB**）**，**并**含**一份**很长的**作者名单****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**读者**不必**去**别处**找**引用格式**——**⭐ 而**对**学生作业**与**论文**而言**，**这**直接**降低了**引用成本**。**⭐⭐ ④ 修改时间与创建时间**相差三个月，**且**与**另三份**保险数据集**同刻变动****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**创建 **2026-06-01**、**平台记录的修改 **2026-09-11T07:28:47Z**；**⭐ 而**同批检索里** `insuranceQADemo`（**07:28:24**）**、**`Insurance_Basic_Training`（**07:21:02**）与 **`AI-ModelScope/Multi-Turn-Insurance-Underwriting`（**07:22:40**）**同在**七分钟内**被改动**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**这类**同刻改动**更可能**来自**平台侧刷新**，**故**本条**不把它**当作**窗口内新增**的证据**（**⭐ 与**本轮另一条的**判断一致**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insqabench]]、**[[ins-mmbench]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、**[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 覆盖**保险与精算领域的**评测集与基准**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**一个**几十 KB**的**保单条款判读**子集**，**其**卡片注明**改编自**另一平台**官方模板**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **评测集**可以**很小**，**关键是**任务与**判定标准**写清楚**；**② **卡片**若**沿用**别人的**模板**，**要**在**第一行**注明**；**③ **把**引用信息**放进**卡片**，**方便**后来者**；**④ **看到**「**刚被修改**」**先**分辨**是不是**平台刷新**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该数据集的任何内容**（**未查看**其**样本条数、**标签体系与**判定方式**）**，**故**不主张**其**任务定义**、**不主张**其**质量**、**也**不主张**其**任何评测结果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**数据集接口返回的**元数据与 **README**；**⭐ 且**该 **README **为**模板化卡片**，**其中**关于**数据本身的**说明**需**结合**其**源基准**才完整**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与** LegalBench 原始项目**的**对应关系与**切分方式**（**⭐ 本词条**只按**其名称**与**卡片自述**记录**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**许可**是否**覆盖**其中**文本的**原始权利**（**⭐ 卡片逐字为 **`cc-by-4.0`**，**而**其**文本来源**可能**另有**权利状态**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**该 **MTEB 机构**账号**与**上游项目**的关系**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条**不把其修改时间**当作**窗口内新增**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条**描述的是**评测用数据**，**不是**任何**保险条款的**权威解读**。

**InsurancePolicyInterpretationLegalBenchClassification**（ModelScope 數據集 `MTEB/InsurancePolicyInterpretationLegalBenchClassification`）**是一個**面向**保單條款解讀**的**評測子集****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**中國的模型與數據集平台：數據集這一面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 ModelScope 數據集介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一個只有 40 KB 的評測集****——**存儲逐字為 40,590 位元組（**約 40 KB**）**、**許可逐字 `cc-by-4.0`**、**下載 21 次**、**類型 4（**數據集）**、**創建 1780308586（**2026-06-01T10:09:46Z**）**、**平台記錄的修改 1789111727（**2026-09-11T07:28:47Z**）****。**⭐ 評測集的價值不取決於體量**，**而取決於它測什麼、**答案是否可判定****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 卡片開頭寫著一行可核對的出處****——**其 README 首行逐字為一條 HTML 註釋 adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface_hub/blob/v0.30.2/src/huggingface_hub/templates/datasetcard_template.md****。**⭐ 即**數據集卡片這一形式本身**也在跨平台流通**——**⭐ 而它把這件事寫在第一行**，**而不是抹掉**。**⭐⭐ ③ 引用寫進卡片本身****——**內含兩份 BibTeX 條目，**逐字含 arXiv 2502.13595（**2025**）與 2210.07316（**2022，MTEB**）**，**並含一份很長的作者名單****。**⭐⭐ ④ 修改時間與創建時間相差三個月**，**且與另三份保險數據集同刻變動****——**創建 2026-06-01、**修改 2026-09-11T07:28:47Z**；**⭐ 另三份**落在 07:21:02／07:22:40／07:28:24****——**⭐ 故**這更可能來自平台側刷新**，**本條不把它當作窗口內新增**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insqabench]]、[[ins-mmbench]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**幾十 KB 的保單條款判讀子集，**其卡片註明改編自另一平台官方模板**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **評測集可以很小**；**② **沿用別人模板要第一行註明**；**③ **引用寫進卡片**；**④ **先分辨平台刷新**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載該數據集的任何內容**，**不主張**其任務定義、**質量或**任何評測結果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀數據集介面返回的元資料與 README**（**且該 README 為模板化卡片**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其與 LegalBench 原始專案的對應關係與切分方式**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其許可是否覆蓋其中文本的原始權利**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該 MTEB 機構帳號與上游專案的關係**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條**不把其修改時間當作窗口內新增**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 本條描述的是評測用數據**，**不是**任何保險條款的權威解讀**。
e.body_en:
This ModelScope dataset **is an evaluation subset for reading insurance policy wording**, its name stating both the task and the source benchmark family. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a Chinese model and dataset platform, on its dataset side.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform dataset interface**: **first, it is an evaluation set of only about forty kilobytes.** The recorded fields give a Creative Commons attribution licence, twenty-one downloads, a dataset type, a creation timestamp in early June and a platform modification timestamp this morning. **The value of an evaluation set does not depend on its size but on what it measures and whether the answers are decidable, so for this project a few hundred judged policy interpretation items can say more about whether a model understands policy wording than a corpus orders of magnitude larger.** **Second, the first line of the card records a checkable provenance.** It is an HTML comment stating that the card was adapted from the dataset card template shipped inside another platform official library, at a stated version. **The dataset card format itself therefore circulates across platforms: a dataset published on a Chinese platform by the benchmark organisation uses a skeleton taken from another platform library, and rather than erasing that fact it puts it on the first line, which is where the discipline of saying which half is yours lands in dataset cards.** **Third, the citation lives inside the card.** It contains two BibTeX entries naming two benchmark papers by their arXiv identifiers, one from 2025 and the original benchmark paper from 2022, together with a long author list, **so a reader does not have to look elsewhere for the citation format, which lowers the cost of citing it in student work and papers.** **Fourth, the modification timestamp is three months after creation and coincides with three other insurance datasets.** Creation is recorded in early June and modification at 07:28 this morning, while three other insurance-related datasets were touched at 07:21, 07:22 and 07:28 the same morning. **Such simultaneous changes more likely come from a platform-side refresh, so this entry does not treat them as evidence of a newly appeared item, consistent with the judgement made elsewhere in this round.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance and actuarial evaluation sets and benchmarks, **while this entry supplies a policy-interpretation subset of a few dozen kilobytes whose card states that it was adapted from another platform official template. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: an evaluation set can be small if the task and the decision rule are clear; when a card reuses somebody else template, say so on the first line; put the citation inside the card; and check whether a recent modification is a platform refresh before treating it as new.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing in this dataset was downloaded**, so its item count, label scheme and decision rule were not inspected, **and no claim is made about its task definition, its quality or any evaluation result**. **Second, only the metadata and readme returned by the interface were read**, and that readme is a templated card, so what it says about the data itself is only complete in combination with its source benchmark. **Third, its correspondence with the original legal benchmark project and its splitting method were not verified**, only its name and its own card being recorded. **Fourth, whether its licence covers the underlying rights in the text was not verified**, the card stating an attribution licence while the text may carry its own rights status. **Fifth, the relationship between the benchmark organisation account and the upstream project was not verified.
